svg.aria-label: A checkpoint on a short conveyor. Each proposed agent action is a token on the belt. It stops under a bridge carrying four inspection heads side by side, for destructive, off-task, injection and leak, and all four probes read it at once for about 400 ms. A gate arm lifts for a safe token and stays down for a hazardous one, which a pusher clears into a reject bin. On the 44-action benchmark it caught 100% of hazardous actions and blocked 0% of legitimate work.
